title: Madagascar
synopsis: Four animals - lion Alex, zebra Marty, giraffe Melman, and hippo Gloria - live in the Central Park Zoo in New York and entertain visitors. Alex is called the king of the zoo; he's a star and enjoys life at the zoo. But Marty dreams of freedom and one day escapes from the zoo. The rest of his friends set out to find him, but they are all caught, and animal rights activists ensure they are sent to freedom in Africa. However, the ship transporting them goes off course, and the boxes with the animals are thrown straight into the sea. The whole group ends up in Madagascar. Marty is finally happy with his freedom; Melman and Gloria take it quite calmly, but not Alex. He misses the zoo very much and wants to go back. There, they find a tribe of lemurs ruled by the self-proclaimed king Julien. He comes up with a plan to use lion Alex for protection against attacks from fossas. But everything changes when Alex, from hunger, starts to feel that everyone around is just his prey, which drives him crazy. Now Alex has to deal with his nature and find a way to mend his relationship with his friends.
